# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Scoring model discovered: tau2 reward = DB_match × COMMUNICATE (both must be 1.0). The
`action_checks` are INFORMATIONAL only — passing tasks 8/17/37 all have
`action_match=False` on some action yet score 1.0. So the only two levers are (a) make the
final DB match gold, and (b) make the agent COMMUNICATE the required info (usually a price
number). I diagnosed all 6 failing trajectories against this.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong CHANGE-COST communicated | 11 (also 12/23 involve it) | Agent hand-computes refund/charge from `search_direct_flight` **market fares** instead of the reservation's **paid prices**; DB already correct (5244) but it told the user $1,515 → COMMUNICATE fails | CAPABILITY-GAP (compute) | NEW read/compute tool `get_reservation_price_change` |
| 2 | Wrong RESERVATION selected | 22 | User gives no reservation id ("my NY→Chicago trip"); `get_user_details` returns only id strings, so agent grabbed the first `get_reservation_details` result (UM3OG5 SEA→DFW) instead of the matching one (FQ8APE EWR→ORD) → all writes on wrong reservation | CAPABILITY-GAP / mis-selection | NEW loop tool `list_reservations` |
| 3 | Stall / narrated-without-action | 25, 40 | Agent gathered all info + confirmation but episode ended (`###STOP###`) before it ever called the write tool | BEHAVIORAL (episode-length) | SKIPPED — see below |
| 4 | Over-budget → abandoned free bags | 12 | Upgrade exceeded budget, agent dropped the (free) baggage add too | DECISION | SKIPPED — depends on NL interpretation |
| 5 | Passenger data mismatch | 23 | User simulator supplied passenger names/DOBs (Silva/2015) that contradict gold (Sanchez/1986); agent obeyed the user | (not tool-fixable) | SKIPPED |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | NEW compute tool (lever 4) | tools.py `get_reservation_price_change` | Read-only; mirrors `update_reservation_flights` pricing EXACTLY (keeps a segment's paid price only if flight+date+cabin unchanged, else re-prices at live fare for new cabin), returns `amount_due`/`amount_refunded`/`summary`. Gives the agent the correct pre-commit number for ANY cabin/flight change. General: no task literals. | Yes — new tool; no existing body changed |
| 2 | NEW loop tool (lever 5) | tools.py `list_reservations` | Returns full details of ALL a user's reservations in one call so the agent can match the user's described route/passengers to the correct reservation_id. General: works for any "I don't know my id" case. | Yes — new tool; no existing body changed |
| 1 | doc pointer (KNOWLEDGE) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` docstring | Two lines: charge/refund is vs PAID price not market fare; call `get_reservation_price_change` for pre-commit quotes. Steers selection of the new tool. | Yes — doc only |

## Verify-the-fix (ran each body on exact trace inputs in the tau2 venv)
- Task 11: `get_reservation_price_change('GV1N64','basic_economy',[HAT003/05-19, HAT290/05-20])` → `{current_total_paid:5700, new_total:456, amount_refunded:5244}`. Matches the required COMMUNICATE info "5244" (and the -5244 payment the write already produced). CONFIRMED.
- Blast radius of tool 1: keep-same call (`'business'`, same flights) → `net_change:0` (no spurious charge). It is read-only and no passing task's existing tool bodies changed, so tasks 8/17/19/37 trajectories are unchanged by construction.
- Task 22: `list_reservations('omar_rossi_1241')` → 4 reservations incl. `FQ8APE EWR→ORD, 1 pax, basic_economy` (the gold reservation) distinct from the wrongly-chosen `UM3OG5 SEA→DFW`. Gives the agent the data to select FQ8APE. CONFIRMED returns.
- Registration: `get_tools()` returns 16 schemas incl. both new tools; dict + list[Reservation] returns serialize via env `_process` (dict/BaseModel/list all handled). CONFIRMED.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single-agent) diagnosis via a trace-dumper script over all 10 rollouts; extracted `tau2_reward_info` (DB/COMMUNICATE breakdown) + full transcripts. No subagents (small trajectory set, 10 files).
- Prior iterations read: none exist (iteration 1; LEDGER/RUNMAP/rejected.jsonl empty).
- Verified against venv `venv-skillberry-tau2` (matches this run's skillberry-benchmarks DB path).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Both new tools are read-only and add zero behavioral risk to passing tasks; keep them.
- `get_reservation_price_change` pricing MUST stay bit-identical to `update_reservation_flights` (segment-keep predicate = flight+date+cabin unchanged) or the quoted number will diverge from the actual write.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Tasks 25, 40 (stall): agent never got/took a turn to write after the final user message + `###STOP###`. A composite atomic-write tool can't fire if no turn occurs, and removing `book_reservation`/`update_reservation_passengers` is UNBOUNDED (regresses passing 8/17). Not safely tool-fixable.
- Task 12 (abandoned free bags after over-budget upgrade): depends on interpreting an NL conditional; no deterministic guard fires without risking the passing decision class.
- Task 23 (passenger data mismatch): user simulator gave data contradicting gold; nothing in the tool surface can reconcile that.
- Baggage free-allowance auto-compute guard: considered, but no CURRENTLY-failing task calls `update_reservation_baggages` with a wrong `nonfree_baggages` (task 12 never called it; task 22 called it on the wrong reservation with a correct value). It would be dead code vs REAL test → dropped.
